name: @sudonym-btc/nmdk
description: Nostr Markets Development Kit aggregate repository.

scripts.test:unit: node --test test/arbiter-compose.test.mjs test/collect-payment-states.test.mjs test/development-proxy.test.mjs test/evm-boltz-trust.test.mjs && bun test test/settle-auction-once.test.mjs
scripts.build:nostr-tools: cd dependencies/nostr-tools && rm -rf lib && bun run build.js && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc
scripts.test:nostr-tools: cd dependencies/nostr-tools && bun test marketplace.test.ts relay.test.ts marketplace/*.test.ts
scripts.test:evm: cd dependencies/marketplace-evm-ts && npm run build && npm test
scripts.test:evm:integration: cd dependencies/marketplace-evm-ts && npm run build && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:nostr-tools && cd dependencies/marketplace-cashu-ts && npm run build && cd ../marketplace-evm-ts && npm run build && cd ../.. && NMDK_REQUIRE_STACKS=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/marketplace-driver-e2e.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:cashu:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:evm:integration && npm run test:matrix
scripts.test:contracts: cd dependencies/marketplace-evm-contracts && npm run build:artifacts && git diff --exit-code -- artifacts src && npm run build && npm test
scripts.check:app: npm run build:nostr-tools && cd dependencies/marketplace-app-ts && npm run check
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:links && npm --workspace @sudonym-btc/nmdk-docs run dev
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:links && npm --workspace @sudonym-btc/nmdk-docs run build
scripts.docs:check: npm run docs:api && npm --workspace @sudonym-btc/nmdk-docs run types:check
scripts.demo:capture:up: npm run demo:browser:install && npm run up && npm run up:arbiters && npm run demo:capture
scripts.demo:capture:fresh: npm run demo:browser:install && npm run down && npm run reset:stacks && npm run up && NMDK_DEMO_CAPTURE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:15178 NMDK_DEMO_CAPTURE_REQUIRE_OWN_SERVER=1 npm run demo:capture
scripts.demo:intro:fresh: npm run demo:browser:install && npm run down && npm run reset:stacks && NMDK_SEED_AUCTION_DURATION_SECONDS=150 npm run up && NMDK_DEMO_CAPTURE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:15178 NMDK_DEMO_CAPTURE_DOCS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:15179 NMDK_DEMO_CAPTURE_REQUIRE_OWN_SERVER=1 npm run demo:intro
scripts.demo:up: npm run up && npm run demo
